title: vatica scaphula
intro: Vatica scaphula, commonly known as the Borneo ironwood, is a plant species that belongs to the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Vatica scaphula include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, and it is used to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues.
